title: Congratulations to Poly Echo! 🎶
body:
A huge congratulations to Poly Echo for earning a place in the **Smokefree Tangata Beats Finals**. They will proudly represent Rosehill College on **20 June** at **Auckland Girls' Grammar School**. We are incredibly proud of your hard work, talent, and dedication. Wishing you all the very best for finals night!
